description: This file defines a 'Button' component using the LightningJS framework. It specifies a template with dynamic content based on internal state, manages state toggling in response to input, and imports external LightningJS modules.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A LightningJS component that toggles favorited state when entered, displaying different text accordingly.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Defines the component's HTML-like structure with dynamic text content based on internal state.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes the component's state variables for managing favorite status and corresponding texts.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handler for input 'enter' event that toggles the 'isFavorited' state variable.
